newsitem.title: ITALY: Likely that Italy 97 GDP will be under 2 pct - Fazio.
newsitem.headline: Likely that Italy 97 GDP will be under 2 pct - Fazio.

text.p: Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio said he expected Italy's economy would grow by less than two percent in 1997 -- under the official government target.
"The best hypothesis is two percent, but it is highly likely that it will be less than that," Fazio said, replying to a question from the lower house of parliament's budget commission.
The government has forecast that Italian gross domestic product (GDP) will rise by two percent next year.
Fazio told parliament earlier on Thursday the tough 1997 budget, which was unveiled last month, might subdue growth. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
